title: DME / TACAN: a Y TACAN and an X DME on adjacent channels + interrogations
description: tools/scene_two.json on 1150.5 MHz, 8 s looped: the TACAN 63Y (1150 MHz, Y replies 30 us, 2700 pairs/s, bearing modulation 237 deg from the beacon, ident TKN) at 60 deg and the DME 64X (1151 MHz, X replies 12 us, 900 pairs/s, ident KDF) at 200 deg in one 2.4 MHz VFO; two aircraft interrogate 126X (12 us pairs) on 1150 MHz from 120 / 300 deg. Each ident is sent once per loop (real beacons: every 30-40 s). Expect a talker per beacon (63Y, 64X) at those bearings, both idents and the TACAN in the event log.
